breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats and reinforces the incorrect approach from the incomplete prompt. It instructs to 'replace the uniform load with its single resultant force W = w × L = 0.3 × 3500 = 1050 N acting as a point load at midspan' and then use the point-load deflection formula for this resultant. This is exactly the error identified in the inconsistency — replacing the distributed load with its midspan resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior. The ground truth simply asks to use the two standard superposition cases (UDL formula and point load formula) without any such substitution. The agent failed to correct this and instead codified the incorrect methodology.
